answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it can vouch or transact, with the stake slashed if peers later prove it vouched for a fake identity. A new agent earns trust only by doing verifiable work over time, so a quill that signs a hundred sock-puppet attestations in a day costs its owner a hundred forfeited stakes. Sybils stop being free: each fake identity needs real capital at risk, and the horizon for recouping that cost stretches past any quick pump-and-dump, so attackers pay more than they can extract.
